reviews.description: Midcurve brings together Switchboard co-founder Mitch and MetaDAO co-founder Kollan, hosted by Hayden from Jito. They discuss oracle infrastructure, restaking and trusted execution environments, then examine the Jito grant experiment, its ongoing outcome market and concerns about trading volume and grant thresholds.
